## Problem / 문제

Describe the user-visible problem and why it matters. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Change / 변경 내용

Explain the resulting behavior and any compatibility or data-format changes.

## Verification / 검증

List the commands or manual checks you actually ran and their results. Separate automated or mocked checks from browser, native Bambu Studio, live LLM, and physical-printer checks. Mark checks you could not run.

## Remaining limits / 남은 범위

Mention unresolved behavior or follow-up work relevant to this change. Remove this section if none.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change includes focused regression coverage where behavior changed, or explains why it is not needed.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Added fixtures, logs, and screenshots contain no credentials or personal data; third-party material has permission and attribution.
